What is Penumbra? Penumbra Foundation is a non profit organization that brings together the Art and Science of Photography through education, research, outreach, public and residency programs. 

We have teamed up with designer Steven Arcella to revamp our logo and create new limited edition tote bags! All of the proceeds help support our programing.
